course.title: Yoruba Language
course.tagline: Speak Yoruba with confidence: greetings, proverbs and everyday talk.

days.title: Say bawo ni and hello
days.goal: Greet people in Yoruba and say goodbye.

video.title: Learn To Speak Yoruba – Lesson 1: How To Greet

steps: Watch today's video and repeat every example of greetings: bawo ni, e kaaro, e kaasan, o daabo out loud as you hear it.
Practise greetings: bawo ni, e kaaro, e kaasan, o daabo aloud for 10 minutes, slowly first, then at normal speed.
Write down five of your own examples using greetings: bawo ni, e kaaro, e kaasan, o daabo.
Record yourself practising greetings: bawo ni, e kaaro, e kaasan, o daabo and listen back, fixing any mistakes you hear.
Use greetings: bawo ni, e kaaro, e kaasan, o daabo in a real exchange today — with a friend, family member or language partner.
days.task: Say bawo ni, e kaaro, e kaasan and o daabo out loud five times each.
days.challenge: Greet someone in Yoruba today, even by message.

quiz.q: What does 'bawo ni' mean?
quiz.explain: 'Bawo ni' means 'How are you?' It is the most common Yoruba greeting.

quiz.q: Which of these is the goal of today's lesson?
options: Hold a short greeting chat in Yoruba.
Greet people in Yoruba and say goodbye.
Name foods and say what you like.
Ask where a place is in Yoruba.
quiz.explain: Today's lesson is about Say bawo ni and hello — its goal is: Greet people in Yoruba and say goodbye.

quiz.q: Which of these did today's lesson focus on?
options: the Yoruba alphabet and its sounds
saying where you are from: Mo wa lati... / Mo n gbe ni...
describing people: ga, kuru, rere, funny
greetings: bawo ni, e kaaro, e kaasan, o daabo
quiz.explain: Today's focus was greetings: bawo ni, e kaaro, e kaasan, o daabo.

checks: You greeted the person in Yoruba
You talked about your day in Yoruba

You listened back and wrote down two things to improve
deliverables: A five-minute audio or video recording of your Yoruba chat
A written list of 50 Yoruba words you know now
A short story you wrote in Yoruba (100 words or more)
A list of your three most common mistakes and how you fixed them
